notes: PDF combines three forms: page 1 FDP Form 10a (Civil Works, 2 projects), pages 2-5 FDP Form 10b (Goods and Services, pages numbered "Page 1"-"Page 4"), page 6 FDP Form 10c (Consulting Services). Civil works form is signed by Dela Serna (BAC Secretariat Head) and Malacora (BAC Chairperson); goods and consulting forms add Espinosa (BAC Secretariat Member) and title Malacora "BAC Chairman".
The consulting form reads "NONE" in every column of row 1 (no consulting services bid out) and is footed "Page 1 of 2"; the second page is not in the PDF.

P.R. 25-11-1602 (MPV, Toyota Lapu-Lapu): ABC printed as 220,000.00 while the bid amount is 2,198,000.00 (bid exceeds ABC); verified on the zoomed image, transcribed as printed. The ABC is probably a typo for 2,200,000.00.
Four goods & services rows (P.R. 25-11-1593, 25-11-1619, 25-11-1603, 25-11-1602) have a printed Date of Bidding of December 23, 2025, i.e. before Q1 2026.
The PDF has an OCR text layer that is unreliable (e.g. it reads the 25-12-1682 ABC as "r 0,052.358.00"); all values were read from the page images (ABC 10,067,368.00 is clear on the scan).

The goods "Name and Address Of Bidder" column repeats the company name in bold above the address; bidderAddress holds only the address. Variants of the repeated name: "NEEDINK SALES & SERVICES", "P & J SEPTIC TANK HAULER & CLEAN UP SERVICES CORP.", "NISSAN CEBU DISTRIBUTORS, INC.", "HERITAGE APPLIANCE ELECTRONICS SUPPLIES & SERVICES", "ACE MEDICAL SOLUTIONS, INC.", "AISON SURPLUS & AUTO PARTS CORP.".
Typos kept as printed: "INDSUTRIAL", "ONE (1) UNITS". The goods form has no No. or Location columns; the last goods page has one empty trailing row (omitted).

bidderNormalized: a canonical spelling added by the transcriber so the same company ranks as one bidder across documents (case, punctuation and obvious misspellings unified, e.g. variants confirmed by the bidder name repeated in the address column or by an identical contact person/address). The printed name is kept unchanged in bidder.
